appearance.title: Embed Appearance
appearance.description: Restyle every embed Atlas sends in this server. Leave a field empty to keep the default Atlas design. Colours accept hex values like #3b82f6.

fields.accentColorHelp: Primary colour for informational embeds. Hex format, e.g. #3b82f6.
fields.colorInfoHelp: Colour for neutral/informational embeds. Empty = accent colour.
fields.colorSuccessHelp: Colour for successful operations. Empty = default green.
fields.colorErrorHelp: Colour for errors and failures. Empty = default red.
fields.colorWarnHelp: Colour for cautions and moderation alerts. Empty = default orange.
fields.colorLogHelp: Colour for audit/log embeds. Empty = default slate blue.
fields.footerTextHelp: Replaces the footer of every embed. Leave empty for the default 'Atlas' branding.
fields.footerIconHelp: Image shown next to the footer text. Must be a direct https image URL.
fields.authorNameHelp: Shows an author line at the top of every embed. Leave empty to disable.
fields.authorIconHelp: Small image next to the author name.
fields.authorUrlHelp: Optional link the author name points to.
fields.showBrandingHelp: Adds a small 'Atlas' footer to embeds that have none.
fields.showTimestampHelp: Keep timestamps on embeds that have them. Turn off to hide them.
